title: SoU-RHS: Bayesian Structured Sparsity for Compact Architecture Recovery in CNNs
abstract: arXiv:2611.24166v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Highly parameterized convolutional neural networks often achieve strong predictive performance, but their memory, computation, and deployment costs motivate the search for methods that recover compact architectures from large reference models. We propose SoU-RHS, a Bayesian structured-sparsity procedure that augments Regularized Horseshoe Shrinkage (RHS) with the so-called Sources of Uncertainty Sparse Global-Local mechanism (SoU-SGL). The resulting model sharpens the separation between active and inactive filters, providing an effective mechanism for architecture recovery. A key property of SoU-RHS is stability: across different overparameterized starting widths and under a reasonable range of pruning thresholds, it recovers compact architectures with similar total size and layer-wise allocation. This supports the interpretation that the procedure is identifying a compact structure adapted to the data, rather than merely compressing eac

translated_title: SoU-RHS：用于卷积神经网络紧凑架构恢复的贝叶斯结构化稀疏方法
translated_abstract: 高度参数化的卷积神经网络通常能取得很强的预测性能，但其内存、计算和部署成本促使人们寻找从大型参考模型中恢复紧凑架构的方法。我们提出了SoU-RHS，这是一种贝叶斯结构化稀疏方法，它在正则化马蹄铁收缩的基础上增加了所谓的不确定性来源稀疏全局-局部机制。所得模型锐化了活跃滤波器与非活跃滤波器之间的区分，为架构恢复提供了有效机制。SoU-RHS的一个关键特性是稳定性：在不同的过参数化起始宽度以及合理的剪枝阈值范围内，它都能恢复出总规模和逐层分配相似的紧凑架构。这支持了这样一种解读：该过程识别出的是适应数据的紧凑结构，而不仅仅是简单地对各层进行压缩。
tldr: 该论文提出SoU-RHS，一种将正则化马蹄铁收缩与不确定性来源稀疏全局-局部机制相结合的贝叶斯结构化稀疏方法，能够稳定地从过参数化CNN中恢复出规模一致且适应数据的紧凑架构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SoU-RHS, a Bayesian structured-sparsity method that augments Regularized Horseshoe Shrinkage with a Sources of Uncertainty Sparse Global-Local mechanism, enabling stable recovery of compact, data-adapted CNN architectures from overparameterized models.
